notes.title: Maze Banquet Engine Update
notes.content:
Maze Banquet has been updated with RPG MAKER MV.

> Multiple execution bug fixes
> More resolution specifications
> Add sound-related options

The following features disappeared during the update.

> Text sound effects
> Auto Save

I ask for your understanding because the script is not compatible with the engine.


No challenges are created in the current build.

We will update it again later, so please wait.

If you have any other inquiries, please post it on the community hub and we will check it out.

Thank you.

notes.title: Maze Banquet Engine Update Announced in Advance
notes.content:
Engine update is in progress to fix many bugs that could not be fixed.

The engine is updated from RPG MAKER VX ACE to RPG MAKER MV
Once updated, old save files cannot be linked.

Please understand that it is for a better play environment by correcting errors.

The errors are corrected and they are updated.
> More resolution specifications
> Add sound-related options

I'll be back with good news soon.
Thank you!

notes.title: August 17th Bug Patch
notes.content: I modified the part where it was impossible to game play.

notes.title: Maze Banquet ver_0.65 Update News
notes.content:
Greetings, thank you for supporting Maze Banquet.

The 2 endings will be included in an update for the game at the end of October.
You will be able to select the King's nominee from 2 more candidates!

But the story doesn't end there.

The true ending will be added to the game when it's officially launched.

Furthermore, when the 1st update is released, the price of the game may increase.
For those who already purchased the game, you may enjoy the update for free :)
For those who haven't purchased the game, we recommend you purchase it before the price increases.

We will bring you more great content through continued updates.
We hope you enjoy the amazing storyline!
